WITH city_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    zc.city,
    COUNT(*) as city_count
  FROM attendance a
  JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
  JOIN zip_code zc ON m.zip = zc.zip_code
  GROUP BY zc.city
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(city_count) as total FROM city_counts
),
city_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    cc.city,
    cc.city_count,
    CAST(cc.city_count AS FLOAT) / tc.total as share
  FROM city_counts cc
  CROSS JOIN total_count tc
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM city_shares
),
above_average_cities AS (
  SELECT 
    cs.city,
    cs.city_count,
    cs.share,
    cs.share - avg.avg_share as above_avg
  FROM city_shares cs
  CROSS JOIN avg_share avg
  WHERE cs.share > avg.avg_share
)
SELECT 
  AVG(city_count) as average_count,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(above_avg) as average_above_average
FROM above_average_cities
